cluster: FIRE DECISION (evaluate during GPS blackout via EKF, critical-fractile firing, never fire late)
summary: The alarm firing path is: LocationManager.positionStream → LocationStreamHandler._handlePositionUpdate → onCheckAlarm → _checkAndTriggerAlarm → _resolveAlarmRouteState → AlarmContextBuilder.build → AlarmController.checkAndTriggerAlarm/_evaluateWithRoute → AlarmEvaluator.evaluateCoinciding. Key findings from reading the real code: (1) The EKF already dead-reckons continuously — SensorFusionManager emits EkfPublicState on every accelerometer sample (sensor_fusion.dart:243-244), so _lastEkfState.s/v keep advancing during a GPS blackout and mode becomes degraded. (2) _handleGpsCheckTick (location_stream_handler.dart:427-452) runs every notificationTick (1-3s) but NEVER calls onCheckAlarm, so NO alarm evaluation happens during a GPS dropout — this is the G10 gap. (3) _resolveAlarmRouteState (trackingservice.dart:1059-1210) already prefers EKF.s for metro/degraded (lines 1176-1185) but only INSIDE the block that snaps the stale _lastProcessedPosition and mutates snap/deviation/session state (lines 1084-1119) — feeding a dead-reckon tick through it would corrupt snap state, exactly what G10 forbids. (4) Speed for ETA is chosen at alarm_controller.dart:580-583 as smoothedSpeed→lastSpeedMps (GPS-derived), never EKF.v (G11 gap). (5) Firing is on the median: etaSeconds <= thresholdSeconds (alarm_controller.dart:680-682 non-metro; alarm_evaluator.dart:243 & 351 metro) and stop-count uses progressMeters >= sm (alarm_evaluator.dart:777) with no sigma cushion (G12/G13 gap). (6) LocationManager (location_manager.dart) has NO accuracy gate and NO getServiceStatusStream subscription (G27/G28 gap). EkfPublicState exposes s, v, sigmaS, sigmaV, mode (ekf_types.dart:7-25). The patches add a central FireDecisionConfig (k=2), drive dead-reckoned evaluation from the existing tick without re-snapping, substitute EKF.v as speed source in metro/degraded/blackout, apply critical-fractile firing to both ETA (time modes) and stop-reach (stops mode), and add an accuracy gate + service-status watchdog to LocationManager.

risks_and_interactions:
Ordering/interactions within the cluster: (1) Apply the FireDecisionConfig new file FIRST — every other patch imports it. (2) The evaluateCoinciding signature patch must land before the AlarmController call-site patch that passes positionSigmaMeters/velocitySigmaMps/fractileK, else compile error. (3) AlarmContext field + constructor patches must land before the builder and the trackingservice build() call are updated. (4) G10's dead-reckon guard in _checkAndTriggerAlarm and the deadReckoned branch in _resolveAlarmRouteState are a pair — apply together; the sentinel accuracy (9999) and the >=9000 predicate and FireDecisionConfig.deadReckonAccuracySentinel must stay mutually consistent. (5) G27 (holding low-accuracy fixes) and G10 compose deliberately: a held fix keeps positionStream silent so _lastGpsUpdate ages into the dropout window and G10's EKF-driven eval takes over — verify they don't double-fire (the _isCheckingAlarm sequential guard already serializes normal + dropout evaluations, and destinationAlarmFiredForKey/firedLegIds prevent duplicate fires). 

Correctness risks: (a) The critical-fractile firing is intentionally biased early; on the surface sigmaS is small so effect is negligible, but if the EKF ever reports an inflated sigmaS while GPS is actually good, alarms could fire early (minor annoyance, acceptable per product priority). (b) etaSigmaSeconds divides by v and guards v>0.5; when stationary underground it returns 0 so firing falls back to median — acceptable because a stationary rider is not about to overshoot. (c) The dead-reckon synth Position has lat/lng = last fix; ensure no downstream consumer of the SAME evaluation writes that back as progress — verified: _resolveAlarmRouteState returns EKF.s directly in the deadReckoned branch and _checkAndTriggerAlarm skips _lastProcessedPosition/_sessionManager ingestion, and the distance-mode straight-line fallback in AlarmController uses currentPosition lat/lng but only when progressMeters is null (progress is non-null here from EKF.s), so the stale coordinates are not used for the fire decision. (d) preferEkfSpeed uses _lastEkfAlarmSnapshot.mode; if the EKF never reaches metro/degraded (e.g. geometry null so EKF disabled), preferEkfSpeed stays false and everything falls back to today's GPS speed — no regression, but also no G10/G11 benefit without an active EKF (route geometry present).

cluster: ROUTE & JOURNEY CORRECTNESS (G14/G15 wrong-direction, G16 OSM/Google stop-count cross-check, G17 route freshness stamping, G18 long-duration journey verification)
summary: Deep-read of the six named files confirms each gap. (G14/G15) ActiveRouteManager._headingAgreement (active_route_manager.dart:273-283) is stubbed to return 0.5 and there is NO signed along-route direction check anywhere; snap_to_route.dart already computes progressMeters monotonically, so wrong-direction is detectable from the sign of delta-progress without any new EKF plumbing. ingestPosition takes only a LatLng, so I use delta-progress (equivalent to projecting velocity onto the route tangent toward the destination), which also works on metro legs where lateral deviation is disabled. (G16) enhanceTransitLegStopsWithOsm (transfer_utils.dart:1164-1394) explicitly logs 'API num_stops (ignored)' and blindly sets numStops = actualNumStops from OSM (line 1368); since firing LATE is product death, an OSM undercount is dangerous — the pre-enhancement `leg` already carries the API count + uniform stopMeters, giving a zero-cost fallback. (G17) RouteCacheEntry (route_cache.dart) stamps only a fetch `timestamp` with a 5-min TTL (line 62); there is no schema version and no planned departure/arrival window, so a stale route cannot be detected across a last-service boundary. (G18) VERIFIED: long-duration journeys are NOT refused at creation. The creation path (homescreen.dart _startTracking, ~line 560-810) validates only (a) cross-state boundary and (b) stops-mode thresholds; `initialETA` (int seconds, line 625) is read but never bounded, and TrackingTerminationPolicy only terminates on sustained >150m off-route deviation (never on duration or on-route station halts), so a 6-10h single-stop sleeper on a KNOWN route is fully supported today. The only caveat: stops-mode inherently cannot express a single-stop leg (validateThresholdAgainstMetroLegs requires threshold < numStops+1 = 1), so the flagship sleeper must use time-before / distance-before mode, which has no refusal. I therefore add only a generous 24h sanity ceiling (to reject corrupt payloads, not real sleepers) plus a total-across-legs duration helper.

Read the real code: lib/core/ekf/{ekf_pipeline,zupt_detector,station_association,motion_classifier,ekf_orchestrator,ekf_types,route_geometry}.dart and lib/services/sensor_fusion.dart.

CONFIRMED DEFECT: pipeline over-states position certainty. onZuptConfirmed forces P[0][0]=min(P00,100) i.e. sigmaS<=10m (ekf_pipeline.dart:463) even though ZUPT is only a velocity measurement (says nothing about WHICH station in a tunnel); and _inflateCovariance clamps sigmaS at 200m (ekf_pipeline.dart:555). Both keep reported sigmaS small while true DR error grows to 100s-1000s of metres -> NEES>>1, feeding StationAssociation a tiny 3-sigma window that yields confident WRONG snaps.

CONFIRMED CRITICAL INTERACTION: window = 3*sigmaS + marginForSigma(sigmaS) (station_association.dart:117; margin capped 150). With maxSigmaS=3000 the window reaches ~9150m so every station is in-window -> MULTIPLE_CANDIDATES (station_association.dart:143-177). That is precisely why 200 was chosen, so G20/A1 is UNSAFE alone and MUST ship with G19/A3.

FIXES: A1 delete ZUPT position-tighten :463 (keep velocity tighten :464), raise maxSigmaS 200->3000 :555. A2 orchestrator derives a smooth-cruise flag from EXISTING band-energy (MotionFeatures.fftTrainEnergy vs fftWalkEnergy) + non-degraded velocity and passes cruiseHint into ZuptDetector.update; cruiseHint vetoes ALL ZUPT paths, closing the degradedUltraQuietPath hole (zupt_detector.dart:71). A3 StationAssociation advances the target index by exactly one per confirmed dwell with a bounded position gate whenever sigmaS>dwellCountSigmaThreshold; geometric single-candidate snap kept for small sigmaS (surface). G21 sensor_fusion feeds gx/gy/gz=0.0 when _lastGyro is null (sensor_fusion.dart:229-231) so an absent gyro silently reads perfectly quiet and over-triggers ZUPT/stationary; detect no-gyro at fusion start, enter no-gyro mode (ignore gyro term, tighten accel thresholds, widen sigma floor, longer dwell, lean on ordinal/schedule).

Ordering: apply A2+A3+G21 support first, then A1 last. A1 without A3 regresses snaps.
